name: set-reminder
description: Draft a reminder for the user. Drafts only — sending needs approval.
steps: parse the what and when into a concrete reminder
draft it and show it to the user for confirmation
only schedule after explicit user approval
validation: reminder shows text, time, and approval state
failure_recovery: keep the draft and ask for a simpler time expression
cautions: drafts only: never schedule or send without explicit approval
never set reminders that trigger irreversible actions
